(* A binary, step-index-free logical relation.  Expressions are related when
   they can evaluate to related values; the value relation is indexed by a
   pair of types and by a relation interpreting free type variables. *)
Definition ty_rel_env := ty_context -> ty -> ty -> (tm -> tm -> Prop).

Fixpoint rel_ty (Delta : ty_context) (rho : ty_rel_env)
    (T1 T2 : ty) (v1 v2 : tm) : Prop :=
  match T1, T2 with
  | Ty_Nat, Ty_Nat => exists n, v1 = numeral n /\ v2 = numeral n
  | Ty_Arrow A1 B1, Ty_Arrow A2 B2 =>
      value v1 /\ value v2 /\
      forall a1 a2, exp_rel Delta rho A1 A2 a1 a2 ->
        exp_rel Delta rho B1 B2 (tm_app v1 a1) (tm_app v2 a2)
  | Ty_All A1, Ty_All A2 =>
      value v1 /\ value v2 /\
      forall U1 U2 (R : tm -> tm -> Prop),
        wf_ty Delta U1 -> wf_ty Delta U2 ->
        (forall x y, R x y -> value x /\ value y) ->
        exp_rel Delta (fun D T U => R)
          (open_ty A1 U1) (open_ty A2 U2)
          (tm_tapp v1 U1) (tm_tapp v2 U2)
  | Ty_FVar X, Ty_FVar Y => rho Delta (Ty_FVar X) (Ty_FVar Y) v1 v2
  | _, _ => False
  end

    (T1 T2 : ty) (t1 t2 : tm) : Prop :=
  exists v1 v2, multi t1 v1 /\ multi t2 v2 /\ value v1 /\ value v2 /\

Fixpoint subst_env (sigma : term_env) (t : tm) : tm :=
